residual_risks: The handler accepts x-vercel-isr: 1 and x_astro_path without the middleware secret, including on _render; whether an external client can supply that header through Vercel ingress was not verifiable without the platform. If it can, clients can select a different Astro route from the one Vercel matched.
testing_gaps: The existing path override security test does not cover an untrusted x-vercel-isr: 1 header combined with x_astro_path on _render; verifying the behavior through Vercel ingress is needed to establish whether the platform removes or overwrites that header.
